notes.title: HFTGOOM wins IndieCade’s 2023 - Innovation in Experience Design Award!
notes.notes:
Getting into IndieCade has been a dream for me for a long time. 

Being nominated means that you can judge games in future years which means you basically get a lifetime of free indie games to play every year. 

Imagine, a whole lifetime to live with endless indie games on the horizon. 

I was satisfied with that since I love games so much.

Despite being content, I ended up winning the Innovation in Experience Design Award. 

I am so grateful to IndieCade for selecting my game for this award. 

I was happy to just be included.

I never thought that I would ever get this far. 

I hope that you will play my next game someday too.

Thank you so much for your support. 

Taylor McCue

notes.title: HFTGOOM has been nominated for the Indiecade Narrative Spotlight Award
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

For years I’ve dreamed of getting into IndieCade and it’s really weird to me to finally be in alongside many developers who I personally admire.

As such I wanted to make a list of my favorite IndieCade games for this year. 

Please consider checking them out. 

[b]Blue Suburbia[/b]: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431510/BlueSuburbia/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431510/BlueSuburbia/[/url]
[i]
Blue Suburbia[/i] is a followup to the greatest game about trauma I have ever played - “[i]Everything is going to be OK[/i]”. 

Even as a demo it’s an incredibly powerful game. 

If you only play one game on this list please pick this one.

[b]BEECARBONIZE[/b]: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2486750/Beecarbonize/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2486750/Beecarbonize/[/url]

A game about trying to prevent the on-going climate collapse from happening. 

This game makes carbon scarier than any zombie apocalypse but is also incredibly fun and addictive. You can spend hours in this game trying to find all the different potential futures of humanity. 

Create your own utopia or dystopia today!

[b]World of Horror[/b]: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/913740/WORLD_OF_HORROR/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/913740/WORLD_OF_HORROR/[/url]

This game is obscenely popular and I don't need to recommend it but I’m going to anyway because I’m a fan. 


[b]Dead Pets Unleashed[/b]: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1851720/Dead_Pets_Unleashed/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1851720/Dead_Pets_Unleashed/[/url]

This game is criminally underrated and I don’t know why this game doesn’t have an incredibly annoying fandom yet. 

Play as a 30 something creative queer whose life is falling apart but is trying one last time to make it as an artist. Mechanically this game is like a visual novel where you can walk around but is filled with a ton of low pressure minigames like Night in the Woods. 

Please give it a chance.

[b](val)iant: or, val’s guide to having a broken vag[/b]: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2388360/valiant_or_vals_guide_to_having_a_broken_vag/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2388360/valiant_or_vals_guide_to_having_a_broken_vag/[/url]

I have written a indie game about medical issues once and it went pretty bad. Despite that I’ve always wanted more medical narrative games to exist and this is exactly the kind of game I’ve wished for. 

I don’t want to spoil it since it’s a short game like HFTGOOM but it’s 100% free and worth your time. 

Well that’s everything from me today. Please consider checking out these games. You can see the full list of IndieCade games here:

[url=https://www.indiecade.com/festival-2023/games/]https://www.indiecade.com/festival-2023/games/[/url]

notes.title: HFTGOOM - BONUS PACK released on Steam today!!!!
notes.notes:
I never really wanted to sell[i] He Fucked The Girl Out of Me[/i], but I need money kind of badly. Unfortunately creating new games takes time. The wallpaper packs were kind of a stopgap so that I could afford to keep making that next game. 

This is a bonus package meant primarily for people who want to donate something so that I can offer something neat in return for their donations.

This bonus pack contains an artbook, playable early versions of HFTGOOM, interviews, bonus games, and other surprises! 

Within the artbook you’ll be able to read through three different parts:

[b]Part 1:[/b] A fictional story that I wrote as a vent piece around the time of the game's story.

[b]Part 2:[/b] Concept Art,  Beta versions of HFTGOOM, and a series of comparisons between the game’s locations and the actual real world locations that they’re based on.

[b]Part 3:[/b] Post-release artwork, interviews, and the previously print exclusive Indiepocalypse Artbook that came with physical cartridges of HFTGOOM.


[h2][b]Saving You From Yourself - Part 1+2 :[/b][/h2]

Play as a therapist who makes major decisions about a young trans woman’s life for her. See the impact those decisions have on her. In [i]Saving You From Yourself - Part 2[/i], see what happens to Arle after the end of[i] Saving You From Yourself[/i], available for the first time on Steam.

[h2][b]Do I Pass?:[/b][/h2]

Have you ever wondered about what other people think of you? 

In [i]Do I  Pass?[/i], Ash gets to learn the answer to this question after she discovers a website of magical spells including one that lets her leave her body and see what people REALLY think of her.
